The readiness gates determine whether features such as enrichment or promotion are enabled. A failure mode occurs if freshness diagnostics are incomplete, masking underlying errors. The system enforces a temporal constraint where data older than thresholdHours is rejected. This ensures that stale data cannot influence pick outcomes. The snapshot structure prevents modification post-creation, maintaining consistency. The readiness gates act as a filter for feature activation, ensuring only valid combinations of data and logic proceed. If any gate fails, the entire ingestion run is marked as failed.
